<!--
  Optional slides and slide parts are switched on and off in _quarto.yml
  (`show:`), or per session with a profile: see the notes there.

  Run sheet (45 min). Speaker notes on each new slide give the timing; press S
  in the browser to open the speaker view.

   0-3   Hook: show of hands on broken phones
   3-5   Rules; teams write down their premium
   5-20  Play the game on the scoreboard
  20-27  What happened: revenue vs expense, again and again, more customers
  27-29  Bridge: "you just did a pricing actuary's job"
  29-37  Careers: areas, jobs, fit, other paths, ANU, student quotes (six slides)
  36-38  Winner announcement (reads the scoreboard)
  38-41  Exit quiz
  41-45  What to do now, questions; backup slides if asked
-->
